tasks.label: Flashear ATmega328P (USBasp)
tasks.command: avr-gcc -Wall -Os -mmcu=atmega328p "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.elf" && avr-objcopy -O ihex -R .eeprom "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.elf" "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.hex" && avrdude -c usbasp -p m328p -U flash:w:"${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.hex":i
